name: Abbott India Ltd
about: Abbott India Ltd is one of the leading multinational pharmaceutical companies in India and sells its products through independent distributors primarily within India.[1] It was established in 1944.[2]
keyPoints:
Abbott Group
The company is a part of Abbott Laboratories, USA which has a presence in 160 countries with leading medical devices, diagnostics, nutrition products, and branded generic medicines. [1]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 19.0% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 34.2%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 72.2%
cons: Stock is trading at 15.7 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.38% over past five years.
Working capital days have increased from 24.9 days to 97.2 days
